reviews.comment: Dr. Dox is a great professor! She clearly cares about the material and all of her students. There is a lot of writing in GLST 201, and they are almost entirely based on lectures in class. While attendance isn't mandatory, I'm not sure an A is possible if you don't hear the lectures. However, if you have decent attendance, the class is super easy.

She is super passionate and cares about what she teaches. The class does require a bit of writing, but it's pretty easy to keep up with. Dr Dox also gives great feedback on each writing and is easy to work with. As long as you enter the class with an open mind and do the short papers, you'll do just fine.

Mrs. Dox is a wonderful lady and so passionate about her studies. The class was a lot of work at times with all the work load being essay based but overall I enjoyed her class. You even get to hear her speak on her own research. So if you don't like writing, do not take this class, but if you are okay with it I would recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love Prof Dox! I was not super thrilled about the class, but it's pretty easy to get an A if you barely pay attention and write well for the assignments. She's super sweet and accommodating (kinda broke down in front of her in the 2nd week of class and she was great about it). She's worth taking, even though the class is a little different.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: She obviously knows her stuff. The lectures could be a bit slow and tedious, but since it was online, I put it on 1.5 speed and got the info I needed. The readings she suggests are really helpful but not mandatory. There were pretty consistent essays and writing assignments, but nothing too hard.
